name: Nagahama Castle
text: Nagahama Castle (長浜城, Nagahama-jō) is a hirashiro (castle on a plain) located in Nagahama, Shiga Prefecture, Japan.

depictions.name: Nagahama Castle
depictions.text: Nagahama Castle is a Japanese castle in the town of Nagahama in Ōmi, Japan.
